newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to stabilise interest rates if necessary.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to stabilise interest rates if necessary.

text.p: A Taiwan central bank official said on Tuesday that necessary measures to stabilise short-term interest rates would be taken if movements become too volatile.

The overnight interbank ended sharply higher at 5.816 percent -- outside the bank's 5.0-5.5 percent target zone -- against Monday's 5.473 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.75-6.00 percent against 5.50-5.60.

Central bank official Peng Chin-tang said the central bank would not like to see volatile fluctuations in short-term money rates, but added that the bank would not take actions based on single-day movements.
"The central bank will take necessary measures at an appropriate time," Peng told reporters.
